description: Doc specifies BMPString/UniversalString will get full RFC 4518 six-step normalization in v0.2, but currently-supported string types (UTF8String, PrintableString, Ia5String, VisibleString) only get partial normalization (case-fold + space rules, not NFKC + Prohibit + CheckBidi). The doc doesn't clarify whether v0.2 will backfill these to full normalization. This creates design ambiguity that a PR reviewer will challenge. Recommend: clarify in doc whether v0.2 brings all string types to parity or keeps them stratified.
title: v0.2 RFC 4518 normalization plan is incomplete across string types
